title: MedicalReportDocument
description: Strict, normative schema for clinical laboratory report records across CBC, Lipid, Diabetes, and KFT panels.

record_id.description: Unique UUID or cryptographic hash identifying this medical report record.

provenance.description: Auditable metadata tracking data origin, record classification, and ingestion history.

data_tier.description: Strict segregation flag distinguishing real clinical records from development datasets.

ingestion_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of ingestion into MediPulse AI.

collection_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of specimen collection.

deidentification_method.description: HIPAA Safe Harbor or Expert Determination protocol applied if real clinical data.

patient_demographics.description: Standardized physiological attributes essential for biological reference interval evaluation.

age_years.description: Chronological patient age in full completed years.

biological_sex.description: Phenotypic or assigned biological sex determining sex-stratified reference intervals.

pregnancy_status.description: Pregnancy trimester or state altering maternal hematologic/metabolic ranges.

fasting_duration_hours.description: Duration of documented fast in hours prior to venipuncture.

panel_type.description: The exact diagnostic panel category for this report.

observations.description: List of measured quantitative or qualitative clinical lab biomarkers.

metric_id.description: Canonical biomarker identifier matching the biomarker dictionary.

raw_token.description: Exact extracted text label from original laboratory report.

measured_value.description: Parsed numeric measurement. Null if specimen was hemolyzed, clotted, or unparseable.

unit.description: Measurement unit reported on laboratory document.

standardized_value.description: Normalized measurement value converted to the canonical unit for this metric.

standardized_unit.description: Canonical unit defined in biomarker dictionary (e.g., 'g/dL', 'mg/dL').

reference_interval_applied.description: Exact biological reference interval applied for this patient demographic.

status.description: Evaluated mathematical status against laboratory reference interval only.

clinical_assessment.description: Clinical evaluation strictly separating biomarker abnormality from confirmed diagnoses.

biomarker_abnormality_summary.description: Objective summary of which laboratory parameters deviated from reference intervals.

has_critical_alert.description: Flag indicating if any biomarker violated critical pan-laboratory notification thresholds.

confirmed_diagnoses.description: List of confirmed medical diagnoses. Must NEVER be automatically derived from a single abnormal test result without supporting evidence.

diagnostic_evidence_type.description: Nature of evidence confirming chronic diagnosis.

verification_source.description: Source clinician, medical record identifier, or clinical registry.

differential_considerations.description: Non-diagnostic clinical differential considerations based on biomarker patterns.
